data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 复用已完成harness优化的经验建playbook并训练编辑器，为各新实例生成harness补丁，跨基准持续复用。

scope_support.feedback_quote: recycles artifacts produced during a completed global harness optimization run, and summarizes them into a structured playbook
scope_support.object_quote: a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process
scope_support.persistence_quote: At inference time, the editor uses the instance and the playbook to construct a tailored harness in which the execution model operates
